TIL spiders have existed for at least 380 million years, making them more than 100 million years older than the first dinosaurs.
TIL about Children’s Games, a 16th century painting that shows more than 90 different children’s games- many of which are still played by kids at recess today.

TIL about Peter Norman, the third guy on the podium during the black power salute; 1968 Olympics. His support to the moment led to issues back in Australia, but Smith and Carlos respected him so much they were pallbearers at his funeral.
TIL that by law every sweepstakes in America can be entered for free.

TIL that in 1921, the U.S. Army exhumed four unidentified WWI soldiers from cemeteries in France to randomly select one for burial at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. Their burial records were deliberately destroyed to preserve their anonymity, and the three not selected were reburied in France.

TIL that when gravitational waves were first observed in 2015, it was because two black holes merged, reaching an energy emission rate greater than the combined power of all light radiated by all the stars in the observable universe.

TIL Scrabble's creator, Alfred Mosher Butts, determined letter distribution by counting letter frequencies in the front page of the New York Times. He limited the game to just four S tiles to discourage players from simply pluralising words.
TIL Canada has the longest coastline in the world
TIL that Elton John has publicly performed Candle in the Wind, 1997 (the rewritten version in tribute of Princess Diana) only once - at her funeral.
TIL there was a go game in progress 5 km away from Hiroshima when the bomb dropped. Play was resumed after the lunch break, and the game was played to a conclusion that evening.
